content.short: Swapr is DXdao's DEX on Ethereum, Arbitrum and Gnosis Chain, with governance-set pool fees and a router that also checks other DEXs for better prices.
content.description: Swapr was built by DXdao as a community-owned exchange. Each pool's swap fee can be adjusted through SWPR governance, rather than fixed at one rate. When you trade, its eco-router compares Swapr's own pools with Uniswap, SushiSwap and 1inch and uses the cheapest path. Liquidity providers can also launch their own farming campaigns to attract liquidity to new pairs. A concentrated liquidity AMM runs on Gnosis Chain. The app now includes concentrated liquidity pools, recurring DCA buys and a bridge, and it supports networks such as Polygon, Optimism, BNB Chain, zkSync Era and Scroll. Users are reminded to open it from swapr.eth.limo or swapr.eth.link.
content.meta: DXdao's DEX with adjustable pool fees, cross-DEX routing and self-serve farming campaigns. Explore Swapr on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
